result.topic_en: Sketch of integration contours (loops around branch points ±a on the real axis) recording the values of the multivalued function i log((ρ+a)/(ρ−a)) on different sheets, with fragmentary formulas involving exponentials and an integral of dr/ρ.

methods.what: Branch values of the multivalued logarithm i log((ρ+a)/(ρ−a)) along contours encircling the branch points, differing by 2π
Representation of r as a sum of exponential terms
Contour integral of 2π dr/ρ along loops, picking up an additional constant 2π²i
